text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey Bouquet-chan, Bouquet-chan♪ Do you 
have any birthday wishes?☆ Curren will do 
absolutely anything for you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, Iâah. Um... thenâ butâsomething 
like thisâ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like— maybe it was too 
presumptuous of a request—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Geez, I told you it's fine~. Don't be shy♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Th-Then, if you wouldn't mind, could I 
have your autograph on this board...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There's a patient long-term hospitalized 
at my family's clinic— and she's a huge 
fan of Curren-chan. I thought... maybe 
it'd cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Sure thing! I'll hand it to you at 
the party, so let's meet up at the Ritto 
dorm once we get back♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We gathered the same flowers Bouquet-chan 
gave us and decorated everything with 
them!☆ The dorm lobby looks absolutely 
incredible right now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh? Y-You'd do that much for me? Even 
though you're already—granting my wish—?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ But it's Bouquet-chan's celebration, 
right? We've gotta properly wish her a 
happy birthday♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-chan makes people happy, so Curren 
is going to be happy with Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan―― I'm so happy... to be your 
friend.
